summary.text: Marvin Abney is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 73 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served as a U.S. Army major for 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Abney earned a bachelor's degree in public administration from Stephen F. Austin State University in 1975, a master's of management from Webster University in 1982, an MBA from the University of Rhode Island in 2000, and a certificate of advanced graduate study in educational leadership from Johnson and Wales University in 2005.

He served as a major in the U.S. Army for 20 years, including a stint as company commander at NATO Headquarters in Belgium, and later worked as executive assistant to the commissioner of the Rhode Island Department of Elementary and Secondary Education.
